title: Understanding the Forces
text: To find the linear acceleration, consider the forces acting on the cylinder. The gravitational force can be split into components parallel and perpendicular to the incline.

title: Components of Gravitational Force
text: The component of gravitational force parallel to the incline is m*g*sin($$\theta$$), where $$\theta$$ is the angle of the incline.

title: Frictional Force
text: The frictional force opposes the motion and is given by $$f_{k}$$=mu_k*N, $$where$$ $$N$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$normal$$ $$force$$ $$and$$ $$\mu_k$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$coefficient$$ $$of$$ $$kinetic$$ $$friction$$.

title: Normal Force
text: The normal force N is equal to the component of gravitational force perpendicular to the incline, which is m*g*cos($$\theta$$).
